content: Activation of cyclic handling of communication data The ability of the RTE to implement a cyclic handling of received communication data is 193 of 1277 Document ID 62: AUTOSAR_CP_TPS_SoftwareComponentTemplate Software Component Template AUTOSAR CP R25-11 controlled by the attribute ReceptionComSpecProps.comHandlerTaskMappin- gEnabled , i.e. the functionality within the RTE is activated if the attribute comHan- dlerTaskMappingEnabled is set to true .
